messages:
Ava: Huge kudos to @infra-team and @oncall for covering the demo outage last night — they had the rollback ready before I even woke up :raised_hands:
Rohan: Seriously, Marcus's quick rollback saved the deck. +1 :100:
Marcus: Thanks team. Paige flagged the bad image tag in the canary logs and we rolled back within 6m.
Paige: did what any slightly-overcaffeinated human would do :coffee:
Priya: shoutout to @ops-bot for the runbook link in the alert — super clear steps
ops-bot: Incident summary: CPU spike on static-pool -> rotated nodes -> restored. See /incidents/2287 for details.
Emma: Also big thanks to Product for the demo pivot on the fly — customers didn't notice a thing
Liam: Can we get donuts at standup? :doughnut:
Ava: Absolutely. Donut run sponsored by Demo Heroes :trophy:
Marcus: Love this. tiny wins = big morale
Rohan: I'll draft a 5-min postmortem and list follow-ups. tagging infra + oncall
Priya: I'll own the canary test improvements. happy to pair on it
Emma: High five emoji chain :raised_hands::raised_hands::raised_hands:
Ava: /poll Who's up for a celebratory snack? options: Donuts, Bagels, Ice cream
Liam: Donuts :+1:
Paige: Bagels
Marcus: Ice cream forever
Ava: Poll closed — Donuts win (tie-breaker: Liam's enthusiasm)
Priya: Love you all. Back to work but needed this moment :heart:
ops-bot: Reminder: If you'd like to add this to the gratitude board, react with :sparkles:
Rohan: :sparkles:
Marcus: :sparkles:
